name: maluos-office-setup
description: Configures a freshly installed MaluOS office (the Business OS kernel) after first boot: an interview that asks for the deployment topology, the business domain and the first administrator, then provisions the kernel, points the office's names at the proxy, hands over the first sign-in, takes provider keys through a protected prompt and reports one topology-aware summary. Every step is a small reviewed script; the whole thing is resumable.
